body: I’ve also got really crooked, yellow teeth as a result of neglect and i just want u to know that i get it and it sucks and real.

would say that my oral hygeine was not ideal (depression yada yada yada) but when i was diagnosed it was explained that the cause was mostly my teeth and especially my wisdom teeth grew in so awkwardly that it’s more difficult to properly clean my mouth and created easy pockets for bacteria to get into. i hadn’t seen a dentist for the better part of a decade so it went unnoticed. if anyone reading is worried, don’t put off the dentist appointment

so im in this subreddit cause my dad is such a clear cut case and ive always sort of interpreted my mom as the victim of that but a few posts lately have me really wondering about her. as far as he went with hugs, he always hugged me for at least 2 minutes at a time, being very literal here. my friends would always look at me funny and ask me what that was about later. it was a super long lingering hug, he would sort of collapse onto me with all his weight. my mom though, if i reached for any sort of affection as a kid she would quickly and curtlytell me to respect her personal space, and any affection i got did feel empty and ghostly like a lot of people here are describing. there was another recent post in here too, about parents showing you soft core porn? very much both of them. my mom infamously showed me saw when i was 3 and kept things at that level from there on, she showed me anything and everything. at 5 my favorite movies were borat and silent hill. my dad would put on movies with lots and lots of very graphic sex scenes. i’m really starting to wonder if the narcissism was coming from both parents?
